http/internal/websocket_messages#

Assembling messages from data frames, and reading Close frames.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Assembling messages from data frames, and reading Close frames.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object WebSocketMessageAssembly#

object WebSocketMessageAssembly does Closing

One owner per incoming message sequence. Control frames leave this state intact and are handled by the connection. No repeated payload concatenation.

close() is void

Closes it.

WebSocketMessageAssembly.accept#

accept(frame is WebSocketFrame) is @WebSocketMessage

Takes a data frame; the message it completes, or none yet. WebSocketFailure for a bad sequence or invalid UTF-8.
